Hi Kelly — really appreciate the clarity on usage projection. Quick summary below of options that map to a hosted-first engagement (no Dedicated yet):

1) Starter Floor (no long-term lock)
   - $4,000/month minimum (applied as a credit against usage)
   - Month-to-month billing; 30-day notice to cancel
   - No volume discount; eligibility for trial credits on first invoice

2) Pilot Commitment (3-month)
   - $10,000/month minimum for 3 months (prepaid/committed)
   - 10% rebate if actual usage exceeds commit by >20% (applies as credit)
   - Under-usage protection: up to 40% of unused commit can be carried as credits to following month within the 3-month window

3) Expansion Band (6-month)
   - $18,000/month minimum for 6 months (committed)
   - 15% blended discount on token unit pricing vs list for committed volume
   - One-time integration credit (negotiable) for early adopters

We can also offer an activation credit to offset first-month charges for pilots where integration work is billed. Marissa, can you confirm current standard trial-credit amounts and whether legal wants a shorter termination clause for the Starter Floor?

Next steps for procurement:
- We can send a short-form MOP (Master Order/Payment) that covers pricing, PO instructions, and termination.
- For purchase orders, we accept PO number + net-30 by default; for faster start we can lock pilot with a credit card on file and convert to PO on month 2.

I'll attach a stubbed rate card and a draft MOP for your procurement team to review. Happy to hop on a 30-min call this week to walk finance through it.

Thanks,

Priyom — quick internal note before we send to Kelly.

We typically offer the following guardrails for Starter vs Pilot:
- Standard trial activation credit: $3,500 applied to first invoice (can make it full activation depending on slide-in integration work)
- For Pilot Commitment (3-month): finance prefers prepaid commits on smaller deals; if Pinwheel needs monthly invoicing we can do monthly invoicing with a 2% processing fee.
- Termination: Starter Floor -> 30-day notice; Pilot -> pro-rated refund on unused prepaid months less integration credit; legal will not accept blanket "rollover forever" language but allow 1-month carry-forward for Pilot and 3 months for 6-month Expansion with written approval.

Pricing nuance: for volumes ~15–40M tokens/month, recommend quoting per-token at the Pilot band pricing (advised at $0.0006/token for generative tokens) with an embedded soft cap to protect against unexpected spikes (we credit overspend above 2x predictable run-rate if agreed up front).

I'll let you and Aditya finalize the short MOP language and the rate card figures. Happy to join the review call.
